svg.title: MariaDB 11.8.8: CSV import durations, 1 run(s)
svg.desc: Logarithmic duration axis, lower is faster. Scriptella batch 1000 is 55.4 times faster than csvsql chunk 1000. Detailed report includes every individual value and unbatched cases.
